# @mikrolab/vendors

> NetLab Vendor Syntax Adapters

Vendor syntax adapters translating CLI syntax for MikroTik RouterOS, Cisco IOS, Cisco NX-OS, Juniper JunOS, Huawei VRP, Ubiquiti EdgeOS, VyOS, Fortinet, Aruba, and OpenWrt into normalized Command Objects.

## Responsibilities
- Module specific execution
- Clean Architecture interface adherence
